title: Remaining-Visit Mileage Allowance on Moved Kessler Care Fleet Plans
content:
# Remaining-Visit Mileage Allowance

A Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans moved onto a replacement unit earns miles on its re-based expiration odometer according to its unused visits. Unused visits are the visits loaded, less visits redeemed, plus visits reinstated, as the plan ledger shows them.

| Unused visits | Remaining-visit mileage allowance |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 3000 miles |
| 3 or more, but fewer than 6 | 1500 miles |
| Fewer than 3 | None |

## Ledger cases (hypothetical, 12 loaded)
| Redeemed | Reinstated | Unused | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | 6 | 3000 miles |
| 7 | 0 | 5 | 1500 miles |
| 7 | 1 | 6 | 3000 miles |
| 10 | 0 | 2 | none |
